Hi Sana / Tom,

Thanks again for the interest in Redwood Inference. We’re running a small group demo next week (public demo + optional 30-minute vendor-focused breakouts for deep integration Qs). I’ve attached a short agenda and the current registrant list so you can see who’s joining.

Current plan: main demo (40 minutes) to cover runtime, deployment modes, and cost controls, followed by optional breakout rooms (30 minutes) split by use case: integrations, compliance, and performance tuning.

Options for the main demo (choose one):
- Tue Dec 7, 10:00–10:40 PT
- Wed Dec 8, 13:00–13:40 PT

Breakouts will run immediately after the main session. If the main slots are full we keep a short waitlist and offer a recording + slots in the next cohort. Please reply with your preferred main-slot or say if you want to be waitlisted. If you want a dedicated breakout for RetailGrid, tell us which topics you’d prioritize (integration, data residency, SLOs).

Attachments: group-demo-agenda.pdf (1 page), registrant_list.csv (simple list).

Thanks,
